what_differs: The Sep 25 discovery decided that one payout cannot mix cash and bet credit, that primary and secondary signups go in separate payouts, that the signup paid flag is split primary/secondary, that one-to-one payment, mixed types per referrer and cancel/delete of an unpaid payout must be possible, that confirmed fraud shows on the referrer record, that primary referrers have no minimum threshold, and that the secondary bonus is a one-time 200 bet credit / 100 cash. WAGR-465 states only the single-currency rule for batches and lists the bonus amount as an open question; the other rules are not in its description, and it has no comments.
suggested_action: Add these rules to WAGR-465 as acceptance criteria (or to the build stories when they are created), and move the secondary bonus amount from Open questions to Requirements after a quick confirmation with Lina.
